capabilities: add the same tags to all notes in a folder
add multiple tags at once via a comma-separated list
trigger tagging from the folder context menu
extras: README notes that tagging the root directory and tagging canvases are not supported yet; docs are usage instructions only with no examples or screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply one or more tags to many notes at once, so users must tag each file individually.
summary: Bulk-tagging utility that adds the same tags to every note in a chosen folder, optionally including its subfolders.
